title: Access-tiering pilot: metered retention, conditional SLA, and automated security-questionnaire mapping
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Summary: Run a 6‑week pilot that tests a composable add-on approach we call 'access-tiering' — offering per-tenant extended observability retention and a premium SLA behind a conditional gating flow tied to an automated security questionnaire and a short contract amendment. Goal is to validate willingness to pay for retention + high-SLA as an adjacency to core hosted usage and to exercise our contract/security automation flow for faster enterprise closes.

Hypotheses:
1) A subset of enterprise customers will pay a material premium (target 6–10% conversion) for 90+ day observability retention when the purchase flow is embedded in the Console and sales motion is light-touch.
2) Coupling longer retention with an opt-in premium SLA (financial uptime commitment + faster incident response) increases average order size and reduces negotiation friction if we present a standardized, automated security questionnaire mapping to contract clauses.
3) Pricing that separates a small fixed subscription fee + usage metering (GB-month retention) will outperform purely percentage-based uplifts in clarity for procurement.

What we'll ship for the pilot (MVP scope):
- Console toggle + purchase flow: a new 'Extended Observability' add-on option that shows projected monthly cost based on historical telemetry (estimate engine).
- Gating logic: small automated security questionnaire (10 items) run in Console; passing certain answers enables the shortcut contract terms and immediate provisioning. Failing answers routes to Sales + Legal review.
- SLA option: checkbox to opt into 'Premium SLA (99.9%, incident RTO 4h)' with a one-click amendment that appends standard language to the MoU.
- Billing model: base fee ($500/month) + per-GB-month retention at $0.12/GB-month; discounts available with 12mo commit.
- Telemetry: telemetry events for funnel steps, conversion, billing activation, and latency/error deltas.

KPIs / success metrics:
- Primary: Conversion rate among eligible trial/enterprise accounts >= 8% within pilot cohort.
- Secondary: Incremental ARR from pilot >= $40k ARR; time-to-close reduction for deals using automated questionnaire <= 10 business days; support ticket delta <= +10% in first 30 days.
- Safety: No measurable increase in tail-latency or token-cost >5% for affected customers; no data residency violations.

Rollout plan and timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (Feb-Mar): finalize pricing, questionnaire mapping, legal template, console mockups.
- Week 1–2: engineering builds Console toggle, onboarding flow, and telemetry hooks (feature-flagged).
- Week 3: QA + security review + legal sign-off; enable pilot feature for internal/test orgs.
- Week 4–7: run pilot with 3–6 customers (pilot list below), iterate on messaging/price.
- Week 8: analysis, decide follow-up (scale, iterate pricing, or cancel).

Pilot customer shortlist (sales agreed):
- AcuHealth Systems (regulated, high retention need)
- NordicPay (payments platform, privacy-sensitive)
- EduLyft (LMS provider, wants longer logs for audits)

Contract & Security Questionnaire work:
- Create a 10-question condensed questionnaire mapped to 6 contract clauses (data retention, encryption at rest, incident notification SLA, subprocessor disclosures, audit rights, portability).
- Automation: answers that meet thresholds automatically enable the standardized contract amendment (no legal redline needed). Answers that trigger exceptions generate a templated follow-up for Sales + Legal.
- Required legal review items: confirm indemnity language, cap, and SLA credits, produce amendment-template (2 pages).

Dependencies & risks:
- Dependencies: Legal (contract template), Billing (metering + pricing engine), Console (UI engineering), Observability infra (ensure retention tiering can be toggled per-tenant), Sales Ops (pilot customer coordination).
- Risks: legal review delays; retention tier implementation could increase storage cost unexpectedly; questionnaire false negatives; enterprise customers pushing for custom terms (countered by offering quick 12mo commit discounts).

Acceptance criteria for 'scale' decision:
- Conversion >= 8% across pilot customers OR incremental ARR >= $40k AND no major legal blockers.
- No critical performance regressions in serving runtime or storage pipeline during pilot window.

Deliverables and owner list:
- Product PRD and pricing matrix (owner: Miguel Santos)
- Questionnaire + automated mapping doc (owner: Aisha Kapoor)
- Console UI + telemetry hooks (owner: Eng frontend lead - TBD)
- Billing integration and estimate engine (owner: Billing eng - TBD)
- Legal contract amendment template (owner: Legal, Natasha Lin)

Notes: This experiment intentionally separates the 'compliance pack' (short questionnaire + amendment) from a broader compliance offering (SOC2/HIPAA). If successful, we will evaluate packaging this as a paid add-on vs. embedding in tiered plans.
